statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia
CPT 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
The service supports diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is clinically indicated to capture the elusive nature of symptoms and correlate them with cardiac rhythm disturbances
